ideas.title: +1 Umbrella Size ☂️
ideas.hook: Every step you take in the storm grows your umbrella by +1. A bigger umbrella blocks bigger hail, so you can push further up the storm path.
core_loop: Walk up a storm path while hail and lightning fall
Gain +1 umbrella size per step under the rain
Hide others under your umbrella for bonus coins
Reach the next shelter to unlock a harsher storm zone
Rebirth for a permanent size multiplier
ideas.twist: Players can share shelter: standing under someone else's giant umbrella gives both of you +1 per step, so big players become moving safe zones.
retention: Rebirth tiers with new storm types (hail, meteor shower, acid rain)
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action sits at 2.20 across 37 new games, led by [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (24,239 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (16,289 CCU). Disaster / weather is at 1.73, carried by [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (10,398 CCU), and the "+1 ___" title formula holds at 2.20.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a body part for no reason; here the stat is a shield against a visible hazard, and big players protect small ones.

ideas.title: Paint Lava for Loot 🌋
ideas.hook: A volcano erupts over your plot every few minutes. Draw channels on the slope so the lava fills your casting molds, not your house.
core_loop: Draw lava channels on your slope before the eruption
Watch the lava flow and fill molds into ingots and statues
Sell the castings for cash
Buy rarer molds and stronger channel paint
Survive bigger eruptions for rarer metals
ideas.twist: Lava ignores plot lines: a badly drawn channel can spill into your neighbour's molds and hand them your loot.
retention: Daily eruption with a rare metal
Plot upgrades that reveal a bigger slope
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.98 across 22 new games with no single leader ([UPD1]⚽ Be a Soccer Legend 10,078 CCU, [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox 8,862 CCU). Paint / create x Ice / fire is a top-4 gap (score 4.14), and Disaster / weather is rising at 1.73 with [UPD 3] Create A Disaster💥 at 4,018 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you hide from lava; here you steer it, and how well you draw decides how much you earn.

ideas.title: Guess Storms for Cover 🌪️
ideas.hook: Clues appear: birds flee, the sky turns green, the ground hums. You have 10 seconds to guess the disaster and run to the right shelter.
core_loop: Read three clues about the coming disaster
Guess which disaster it is
Sprint to the matching shelter (basement, rooftop, hill, boat)
Survive and earn coins, or get ragdolled
Spend coins on clue hints and shelter skins
ideas.twist: One shelter is always fake. Players who guess right can lock its door, so the round gets tense near the timer.
monetization: VIP pass with an extra clue each round
retention: Weekly new disaster added to the pool
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess is at 1.18 (Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] 3,272 CCU, [🎃] Don't Say The Obvious! 925 CCU), and Quiz / guess x Disaster / weather is an open gap (2.63). Disaster / weather is at 1.73 and the Escape subgenre is up 0.71 this week to 1.79.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games are seated; here a right answer only counts if you run to the shelter in time.

ideas.title: Pump Air for Astronauts 🚀
ideas.hook: Run the only oxygen station on Mars. Astronauts and robot couriers line up for air tanks, and a dust storm doubles demand.
core_loop: Pump and fill air tanks
Serve the astronaut and robot queue
Earn cash and buy bigger pumps and tank racks
Hire robot helpers to refill shelves
Expand the dome before the next dust storm
ideas.twist: During dust storms, prices spike but your pumps clog. Players who clean filters in the storm earn triple.
retention: Dome expansions that unlock new customers
ideas.why_now: Space is at 1.66 with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (12,103 CCU at 17 days) and [MARS] Clean the Moon! (3,987 CCU). Robots / mechs is at 1.68 and Sell / run a shop at 1.35 across 31 new games, led by Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (16,551 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Space games are about cleaning; this is a shop where the product (air) is the thing everyone on Mars needs.

ideas.title: Roll for Parole 🎲
ideas.hook: Four inmates, one giant board laid over the prison yard. Roll dice, play item cards and be first through the gate.
core_loop: Roll dice to move across the yard board
Land on tunnels, laundry carts or guard checks
Play item cards (spoon, map, bribe) to skip or block
Reach the gate first to win cash
Buy card packs with rarer items
ideas.twist: Guard spaces send you back to your cell, but you can play a card to send the guard after the leader instead.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards is up 0.46 this week to 1.23, with [🎉UPD 3] Roll A Stickman! at 5,992 CCU. Prison / police is up 0.18 to 1.44 (13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] 6,142 CCU, Punch Out Of Prison 3,478 CCU), and Dice / cards x Prison / police is an open gap (2.65).
ideas.differentiator: Prison escapes are solo grinds; this turns the escape into a short board game you play against friends.

ideas.title: Be a Quiz Millionaire 💰
ideas.hook: Answer quick trivia, but first bet your cash on how sure you are. Bet big and be right to become a millionaire in one round.
core_loop: See the category, then place a bet
Answer the question in 8 seconds
Win or lose your bet
Climb the cash leaderboard each round
Spend cash on a mansion lobby and outfits
ideas.twist: The poorest player each round gets a free 'lifeline' that shows how the richest player answered.
monetization: VIP pass with a bigger starting bankroll
retention: Daily category with a bonus pot
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess x Money / rich is the second-biggest gap in the data (4.63). Money / rich is at 1.71 across 54 new games with no single leader, Quiz / guess is at 1.18, and the "Be a ___" formula is at 1.11.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games reward the right answer; here the bet matters as much, so a confident wrong answer can wipe you out.

ideas.title: Be a Factory Bot 🏭
ideas.hook: You are a half-built robot on a conveyor belt. Dodge presses, welders and paint sprayers and escape the factory before you get boxed.
core_loop: Ride the conveyor and dodge machines
Get hit and lose parts (ragdoll physics)
Collect spare parts to repair and upgrade
Reach a new floor of the factory each run
Unlock new robot bodies
ideas.twist: Parts you lose stay on the belt; other players can grab them and bolt them on.
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is at 2.24 (up 0.40 this week) with [🎩] Ragdoll Research at 10,882 CCU at 12 days. Interiors are the top map style at 2.14 and realistic art is at 2.02. Escape / run is at 1.57 and Robots / mechs at 1.68.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games have no goal; here every hit costs you a part and the factory is a run you try to finish.

ideas.title: Build a Coral Reef 🪸
ideas.hook: Grow coral on your patch of seafloor. Bigger, brighter reefs attract rarer fish, and rare fish pay you to live there.
core_loop: Plant coral seeds on your seafloor plot
Water-feed them as they grow
Rare fish arrive and pay rent
Sell coral cuttings to buy rarer seeds
Expand your plot deeper
ideas.twist: Storm surges break off coral; it drifts to other plots, so you can find rare coral washed up from a neighbour.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is up 0.47 this week to 1.53 across 41 new games ([2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution 8,683 CCU, [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 8,152 CCU). Ocean / pirates is up 0.30 to 1.19, and [🐟] Net a Fish! is at 16,263 CCU. The "Build a ___" formula is up 0.23 to 1.15.
ideas.differentiator: Grow games are on land; here the crop is a habitat and the reward is the creatures it pulls in.

ideas.title: Draw Legs for Races 🦿
ideas.hook: Draw your robot's legs with your finger. Physics makes them walk, wobble or fall, then you race them over hills and gaps.
core_loop: Draw a leg shape for your robot
Watch it walk with real physics
Race other players over a course
Earn bolts for finishing
Unlock new body parts and ink types
ideas.twist: You can redraw your legs mid-race, but every redraw costs a second, so you have to plan for the terrain.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create x Robots / mechs is the third-biggest gap (4.26). Paint / create is at 1.98 with Draw a Flag! showing drawing in new games, Physics Sim is at 2.24 and Robots / mechs at 1.68.
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games are judged on looks; here your drawing is the machine, and it either walks or falls.

ideas.title: Haul Supplies for Survivors 🚚
ideas.hook: A hurricane is coming. Load your truck with water and food, then drive through flooded roads to towns before the storm hits.
core_loop: Load supplies at the depot
Drive through flooding roads and falling trees
Deliver to towns before the storm arrives
Get paid more the closer you cut it
Buy bigger trucks and storm upgrades
ideas.twist: Each run the storm path changes, and roads you used last time may be gone.
ideas.why_now: Vehicle Sim is at 1.60 (up 0.26) with Low Range: Offroad 4x4 [EARLY ACCESS] at 12,626 CCU. Disaster / weather is at 1.73, realistic art at 2.02 and linear courses at 2.10 (DONT SPLASH at 45,709 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you hide; here you race the storm and the risk is what pays.
